Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged and underperforming tech positions immediately.
plays: Review and adjust protective stops for SOXL and SPAL immediately; current 'default stops' are not active given deep losses and leveraged nature.
Respect the QQQ stop at 670 and QQQI stop at 52. Consider trimming SMH as per its scanner status.
No new buys today - hold and watch. Current market mood and existing portfolio risks suggest caution.
